about: The Rebbeim's pictures on their cards (the towns, the ohalim, 770; owner, Nov 6 2026: next to each name, in a proper gilded frame): web/img/rebbeim/<key>.jpg at 300x375, made by scripts/head-photos/rebbeim-portraits.py from the source kept in work/head-photos/rebbeim/<key>.jpg ('box' is the crop in that source's pixels; 'fill', rare, an area painted over with the backdrop first; 'fit', a sefer's title page shown whole on white). The Alter Rebbe's and the Tzemach Tzedek's are the traditional portraits, not photographs; the Rebbe Rashab's, the Frierdiker Rebbe's and the Rebbe's are photographs. No picture of the Mitteler Rebbe is known, and the portrait attributed to the Rebbe Maharash (printed in HaMivaser, 14 Kislev 5773) is probably not him (owner, Nov 6: 'cancel the maharash'): for these two, the title page of a sefer of theirs, as Chabadpedia does (owner: 'Do how chabadpedia does it with like the sefer shaar blatt'). Those two came from a Firecrawl screenshot of Chabadpedia's file page (chabadpedia.co.il refuses our downloads), the page's preview cut out of it. The Rebbe's picture changes with his age on the history page (owner, Nov 9: 'Make the Rebbe's picture change as he got older'; proper portrait-like photographs, colour where there is colour): the-rebbe-1950s until 1959, the-rebbe-1960s 1960-71, the-rebbe-1970s 1972-83, the-rebbe (colour, about 1987, also the main map's) from 1984. No colourised photograph of the Frierdiker Rebbe was found (the colour ones are paintings), so his stays the black-and-white photograph.

the title page of לקוטי תורה - תורת שמואל (שער תשיעי, ספר תרכ״ו), Otzar HaChassidim: Chabadpedia's picture for him
photograph, 'The Rebbe in the early 1950's' (the gallery's caption); on the history page until 1959 (the 1940s too: no portrait of those years found)
photograph, undated in the gallery: the beard going grey, as in the 1960s; on the history page 1960-71
colour photograph at a parade, undated in the gallery: the beard grey, the moustache still dark, as in the 1970s; on the history page 1972-83
colour photograph, about 1987 (the file's name); the main map's, and the history page's from 1984 (it replaced a black-and-white one from chabad.org, owner, Nov 9: 'a color one of the Rebbe')
